name: PHerc0500P2 gen_00371 + gen_00377 (held-out segments)
summary: Native 9.36 µm / 113 keV surface volumes; Reader V3, Reader v2 and dense_native 16k. Reference: the team's 2.2 µm ink map of each segment (a model prediction on a 4× finer scan, not ground truth). Segments gen_00371 and gen_00377 are not in Reader V3's or Reader v2's training list; 18 other 0500P2 segments are (checked in the configs embedded in reader-v3.pth and reader-v2-step040000.pth). dense_native 16k is also held out here (the ink_9um labels contain no PHerc0500P2).

nodes.question: Does the model see known ink on this labelled segment?
nodes.answer: PARTLY: significant agreement but not letter-level for every held-out checkpoint (WEAK).
evidence: Brackets: 95% CIs from a 2 mm tile bootstrap that keeps the registration fixed. They give precision, not significance; significance is the shift-null p-value.
Held-out checkpoints: 0 PASS, 6 WEAK, 0 FAIL (best: Reader V3 vs 2.2 µm map, gen_00371, r_bp 0.44, stroke recall 0.32 vs chance 0.07; recall − chance +0.25, 95% CI [+0.16, +0.34]).
